identity: The Battlegrounds' war camps of both factions, mining camps of the Miner's Guild since Round 58: their foremen's quests.

quests.title: The Whole Camp's Pay
quests.text: The emberglass and ruby orders are filled; this routine receipt records the camp pay that provides for the guards and the work crews together. Take this receipt to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc for The Charter of Stone.
quests.completion: The guard detail and the work crew are both covered by the camp's pay receipt. The Charter of Stone checks that because a defended camp still needs hands to keep it running. I will mark this receipt accounted for.

variants.text: Both orders are settled, and this receipt records the camp pay for fighters and workers; I have checked the workers' total twice. Take this receipt to Alis Cartwright at the Miner's Guild house in Highcourt for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: Here is the provision for the fighters, and here is the workers' share of the same camp pay. The Charter of Stone follows both through the books; otherwise a cart can arrive on time and still leave half the camp waiting. This receipt is in order.

variants.text: The emberglass and ruby are accounted for; I also have the regular receipt for the camp pay that feeds both our fighters and our workers. Take this receipt to Alis Cartwright at the Miner's Guild house in Highcourt for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: Here is the provision for the fighters, and here is the workers' share of the same camp pay. The Charter of Stone follows both through the books; otherwise a cart can arrive on time and still leave half the camp waiting. This receipt is in order.

variants.text: Both orders are filled; this ordinary receipt covers the camp pay for the fighters holding our ground and the workers keeping it supplied. Take this receipt to Caelir Veinward at the Miner's Guild house in Lethariel for The Charter of Stone.
variants.completion: The camp's pay provides for the people holding its ground and the people working it. The Charter of Stone records both, so the next supply plan reflects the whole camp. I will keep this receipt with theirs.

quests.notes: Round 58 follow-up of tier 5 (The Charter of Stone): story seed: A regular receipt records that a war camp's pay supplies both its fighters and its workers.

quests.title: Everyone Under the Banner
quests.text: Both orders are settled; the camp's regular pay receipt records provision for the workers alongside the fighters. Take this receipt to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr for The Oathdelvers.
quests.completion: Fighters and workers, both entered under the camp's ordinary pay. The Oathdelvers keep both sets of names in the account. I will file this receipt against their provision.

quests.title: A Separate Record
quests.text: Your crystal and diamond orders are filled; the salvage crew's record is ready too, with the names they recovered and the personal belongings entered apart from usable material. Take the salvage record to Hadrin Beamset at the Miner's Guild house in Dur Brannoc; The Charter of Stone will see it properly recorded.
quests.completion: The recovered names and personal belongings go in their own record; the usable material gets a separate tally. That is how The Charter of Stone files a salvage return. I will keep the names where someone looking for a person can find them.

quests.title: What Comes Back With a Name
quests.text: The crystal and diamond orders are filled; this salvage record preserves the recovered names and personal belongings separately from the material we can put back to work. Take the salvage record to Iven Lastshift at the Miner's Guild house in Nhal Veyr; The Oathdelvers will see it properly recorded.
quests.completion: I will enter the recovered names and personal belongings together, and file the usable material separately. The Oathdelvers keep a place for anyone who comes seeking a name. They should not have to search a materials ledger for it.

quests.title: The Camp Still Needs Feeding
quests.text: Charnel Bears follow the smell of our provision loads through the bonewood and have little patience for the people carrying them. Hunt eight Charnel Bears by day in the {name:bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:bonewood}. I have enough mouths to feed without adding theirs.

variants.text: Charnel Bears follow the smell of our provision loads through the bonewood and have little patience for the people carrying them. Hunt eight Charnel Bears by day in the {name:bonewood}, which lies {zone_area:bonewood}. I have enough mouths to feed without adding theirs.

Saltroad Deserters keep picking off our supply runs under the trees. Defeat eight Saltroad Deserters by day in the {name:cloudwood}, which lies {zone_area:cloudwood}. I am tired of counting a full crew out and wondering how many will come back.

quests.notes: Round 58 camp hunt: one shared quest per camp band and clock, given by the camps' foremen; a role near the camp (the camps' level belt L51-53) that the zone's own quests do not hunt yet, met by day.

quests.title: One More Shift
quests.text: Embergrit Gnawer swarms keep sending our haulers stumbling across the pale slopes with their loads. Kill eight Embergrit Gnawers by day on the {name:whitewall}, which lies {zone_area:whitewall}. Down a mine or out in the open, I still have to get this crew home.

Last-Watch Mummies keep attacking the supply crews beneath the high branches. Defeat eight Last-Watch Mummies by day in the {name:high_canopy}, which lies {zone_area:high_canopy}. My workers are owed the end of their shift, and I would like to give it to them.
